name: Greenshield-Pattern Sword
description: The elven Greenshield's standard military sword — a straight double-edged blade of refined elven metallurgy, balanced for the cut-and-thrust technique Greenshield doctrine emphasizes.
narrative_effects: Supports standard sword technique with the specific balance elven military training favors.
Rare in realm-side hands; its presence on a non-elf signals either long-term elven relationship or a trophy whose provenance is worth asking about.
